reasons: The cited passage is present at star page *698 and supports the proposition about calling an informant while concealing informant status.

defect.evidence_quote: A rule thus declaring "prosecutor may hide, defendant must seek," is not tenable in a system constitutionally bound to accord defendants due process.
defect.locator_note: pin-696; text/Banks v. Dretke__222955.txt line 72, page *696
defect.problem: The quote changes the opinion's internal double quotation marks around the slogan to single quotation marks. That fails strict character fidelity, although the sentence and pincite are otherwise correct.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace the inner single quotation marks with double quotation marks: "A rule thus declaring \"prosecutor may hide, defendant must seek,\" is not tenable ..."

reasons: The opinion text at star page *696 contains the same sentence with double quotation marks.
The lake pinpoint itself records quote_fidelity as mismatch.
residual_risks: Support and pincite appear sound; only strict quote punctuation needs correction.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the sentence but make the quotation marks character-faithful.

defect.evidence_quote: The evidence at issue must be favorable to the accused, either because it is exculpatory, or because it is impeaching; that evidence must have been suppressed by the State, either willfully or inadvertently; and prejudice must have ensued.

defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-691's stored quote with the actual page-691 Brady/Strickler components sentence from the opinion text.
